submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.0180%) at Sb=0.84. EQE falls on both sides at high Sb: 0.0093% at 0.78 and 0.0163% at 0.865. XRD at idx 25 shows a rutile-type phase (strong peaks at Q≈1.88, 2.65, 3.55), consistent with a Sb-rich rutile alloy. Stoichiometric CoSb2O6 (idx 18) was nearly inactive, and the Co-rich side (idx 10) was lower.
